locked_story.headline: THE DIPLOMA GETS A CLOCK
locked_story.one_line: The University of Alaska Board will discuss a draft AI Engaged framework that promises earned competence, human oversight, universal AI literacy, and institution-level policies within one year while leaving curriculum decisions with UAA, UAF, and UAS.
locked_story.story_question: Can a statewide AI framework protect what a University of Alaska credential means without taking academic judgment away from its three universities?
why_this_one: The Board meets in Juneau today and tomorrow, which gives the story a same-day public hook.
The AI angle is the subject itself rather than an editorial bridge from unrelated technology.
The draft contains a visual operating system with six principles, four priorities, five implementation expectations, and a one-year policy clock.
The tension is earned and testable. Systemwide consistency has to coexist with faculty judgment, human oversight, and three separately accredited universities.
The story is distinct from every Dispatch inside the thirty-day dedupe window.
The draft label is load-bearing. The film must never say the Board adopted or funded the framework.

dedupe.entities_checked: University of Alaska Board AI Engaged, systemwide AI Coordinating Council, consequential AI admissions financial aid advising HR analytics, institutional AI policy within one year
dedupe.first_check_note: A broader phrase set collided on generic words earned and one with the August 7th salmon-robot story. The honest distinctive set is fresh.

locked_story.stance_intent: Constructive scrutiny. Treat the draft as a serious attempt to turn AI from scattered tool use into an accountable university operating framework, then measure it against its own one-year clock and earned-competence promise.
locked_story.verification_status: Primary documents verified. Three independent adversarial reads completed: the credential and human-oversight angle is fully supported; the shared-infrastructure and separate-budget angles are retained only as secondary context with explicit limits.

known_source_limits.limit: The statement is labeled DRAFT and appears as a presentation or update. The posted agenda shows no adoption motion. Say will discuss or proposes, never adopted, enacted, or now requires.

The $300,000 UASO AI and enterprise automation item is a separate FY28 budget request in the same Board package. It must not be described as funding for the AI Engaged framework unless the Board documents expressly link them.
The sources show no measured outcomes, public reaction, completed policy, or deployed consequential-AI system. The one-year clock begins only if the draft is adopted.
